summary: T02 implementation conforms to the saved plan: host setup config schema and safe IO helpers exist under src/awf/host_setup, source-checkout validation returns explicit verified asset handoff objects with reason-coded diagnostics, the required unit test file covers round-trip permissions, secret rejection, corrupt config, valid/missing/unreadable/stale source checkout cases, and the validation artifact records targeted pytest, ruff, and mypy evidence while leaving broad AWF/GitHub validation to the post-agent phase.
